dataset: Natural Earth 1:50m cultural vectors – populated places and breakaway / disputed areas
description: Public-domain geographic context: about 1,250 capitals and major cities with population estimates, and 28 breakaway, disputed and indeterminate areas with Natural Earth's notes on who administers and who claims them.

coverage.temporal: Static reference data, revised with Natural Earth releases (5.x)

updateCadence.upstream: Occasional Natural Earth releases (months to years apart)

attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.

license.name: Public domain (Natural Earth terms of use)
license.notes: "All versions of Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the public domain." No permission or credit is required. Files are fetched from the project's official GitHub repository (nvkelso/natural-earth-vector).

limitations: Boundaries and names of disputed areas are cartographic depictions by Natural Earth, which shows de-facto control; they are NOT an endorsement of any territorial claim by this application, and other authorities draw them differently.
The administering / claiming notes are Natural Earth's short editorial summaries and can be outdated (the status of several areas has changed since they were compiled).
Outlines are generalised for 1:50 million scale and are unsuitable for measuring or for locating a point relative to a line of control.
Population figures are estimates of metropolitan areas from mixed years (mostly 2000s–2010s), not current census values; the city list is a cartographic selection, not a complete gazetteer.
The country attached to a city is Natural Earth's de-facto admin-0 assignment (e.g. Somaliland, Northern Cyprus are separate units).
confidenceNotes: No per-record confidence is published. Volunteer-maintained cartographic reference data intended for small-scale maps; positions of cities are reliable to a few kilometres, disputed-area outlines are indicative only.

retention.note: Reference data: a feature is kept for as long as the current file lists it.

layers.name: Cities & capitals
layers.description: Capitals and major populated places from Natural Earth (1:50m) with population estimate and capital status.

layers.name: Disputed & breakaway areas
layers.description: Breakaway, disputed and indeterminate areas as depicted by Natural Earth (de-facto control), with its note on who administers and who claims each area. A depiction, not an endorsement.
